distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Fujian (Nanping). Huang & Lu (2015) reported Fujian. These are literature-based records; the regional occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending independent checklist review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Hunan as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Host names are retained as reported in the cited literature. Each host is linked to its supporting source; 2015 may repeat 1984 evidence rather than provide an independent confirmation. Host associations have not yet been independently reviewed.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Phloeosinus machilus (Schedl, 1959).
